property_hierarchy.property_comment: Top header band: 'Randomization' (V3 only), 'Double-Blind Treatment' spanning V4-V7, 'Early Discontinuation' (ED; printed 'Early / Discontinu / ation', a word broken by the narrow column without a hyphen). Typed by the value that spans several columns (a study phase) -> epoch; single-column values stay values of the band. The label cell prints the table heading 'H0P-MC-OA03 ISA', so the name is synthesised.
Study week per visit: 0, 2, 4, 6, 8; blank for ED -> week.
Allowed deviation in days: blank for V3, '±3' in each of V4-V7 (four ruled cells), blank for ED -> window; a qualifier of the columns, so hierarchical_level null.

Shaded, bold-labelled row printed with the header on every page: one mark 'X' with footnotes a, b in the V3 column, the rest blank. Its Notes cell says there are 2 telephone visits between Visit 3 and Visit 4, 4 and 8 days after Visit 3 (footnotes a, b). Typed visit_attribute (a mark on a visit column that says something about that visit's interval, like a fasting row); it does not tell columns apart, so hierarchical_level null. Whether it is a header row at all is review item D1.

unified_annotations.annotation_text: This SoA shows visits and procedures unique to the intervention-specific appendix (ISA) H0P-MC-OA03 (OA03) for LY3556050. Please refer to master protocol CPMP and the OA DSA CPMP(1) SoAs for additional information.
Visit occurs 4 days after Visit 3 [remainder redacted in source]
Visit occurs 8 days after Visit 3 [remainder redacted in source]

Visit window +2 days
There will be 2 telephone visits between Visit 3 and Visit 4:
V3-V7: Do symptom-directed physical examination
V3, V5 and V7: Single ECG before in-clinic dosing and at 3 hours after dosing
V4, V6 and ED: Single ECG
ECG includes collection of PR interval, QRS duration and interval, and heart rate.

Blood Pressure
Collect orthostatic blood pressure after 5 minutes supine and then 2-3 minutes after standing and collect pulse after supine and standing blood pressure.
Temperature and Respiratory rate
Collect once at each visit
V3, V5, and V7: Collect blood pressure and pulse in supine and standing position, before in-clinic dosing and at 3 hours after dosing
V4, V6 and ED: Collect blood pressure once

Intervention is taken orally, twice daily (BID), approximately every 12 hours.
Refer to Section 6.6 for dose titration scheme.
V3, V5, and V7: Participants take the morning dose in the clinic.
Performed at investigator discretion
For WOCBP only

For WOCBP only
Collect sample within 24 hours prior to first dose.
V3: Collect 3 hours ±15 minutes after dosing.
V5 and V7: Collect samples before dosing and 3 hours ±15 minutes after dosing.
V4, V6, and ED: Collect single sample at any time.
Record date and time of collection.
Not printed in the source: the Notes cell of this row is covered by a redaction box labelled 'CCI'. [remainder redacted in source]

review_items.call_made: The shaded 'Telephone visit' row, printed with the header on every page, is recorded as header row 5 (schedule_property, visit_attribute, level null) with 'X' and footnotes a, b in the V3 grid cell. The two telephone visits it announces (4 and 8 days after Visit 3) are not columns of the table.
review_items.alternative: Record it as an activity row 'Telephone visit' with one mark at V3 (counted once), or as two visits of their own between V3 and V4 (which the table does not print as columns).

review_items.call_made: The shaded 'Procedures' band under the header (p.11 only, spanning the label and visit columns) is read as a label for the activity column and not emitted; its row position 6 is left unassigned, and rows 7-12 stay at level 0.
review_items.alternative: Emit it as a mark-free group row at level 0, with rows 7-12 (Evaluate all I/E criteria ... Intervention compliance) as its level-1 children until the 'Laboratory Tests and Sample Collection' band.
